name: elaichi
description: Call tools across Salesforce, Slack, Jira, Notion and 650+ other apps, limited to each person's own access

setup.notice: Requires an Elaichi workspace with at least one app connected.
steps: Create an Elaichi workspace and connect the apps you want Devin to use
If your team manages connections centrally, ask an admin to share a toolbox with you
